statement: Kernel wired IBEX sets lizard mode during registration according to lizard_mode policy: enabled branch sends feature1 [0x85] then [0x8e] (default digital mapping and settings); disabled branch sends feature1 [0x81] then [0x87,0x06,0x09,0x00,0x00,0x47,0x00,0x00] (disable lizard setting 9 and watchdog-enable setting 71). All writes use feature ID1 with 64-byte request buffer padded as needed; send return errors are not propagated by steam_set_lizard_mode, whose return type is void. hid-steam.c:145-245,517-585,873-911,1402-1407. No verified response payload for SET_REPORT.
